correctness.rationale: For \(F_{a,b}=\exp(2\pi iab/p^k)\), tightness is exactly vanishing of every off-diagonal row-Gram entry. A difference of valuation \(v\) produces a primitive \(p^{k-v}\)-th root, so its vanishing is equivalent to divisibility by \(\Phi_{p^{k-v}}\). The product of all distinct required factors divides the mask, giving \(p^{|R(A)|}\mid |B|\) at \(X=1\). The explicit digit mask is exactly that product and has 0/1 coefficients by uniqueness of base-p expansion. The verifier uses exact integer polynomial arithmetic and agrees exhaustively for all nonempty A and B in orders 4, 8, and 9.
